_description: MFS filer — SS is always 85% taxable regardless of provisional income.
_rationale: MFS filer, Florida, SS $20k + pension $30k at age 62, haircut disabled. MFS rule: 85% of SS is always taxable = $17k. Combined taxable gross = $47k. Deduction $16,100 (2026 MFS). Taxable = $30,900. Federal tax = $1,240 (10% on $12,400) + $2,220 (12% on $18,500) = $3,460. Net = $46,540/yr.
name: SS MFS Always 85%
